bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed. All bags are subject to search.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12" x 6" x 12"
One sealed water bottle or empty reusable bottle, up to one gallon
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the clear bag policy
Weapons, including pocket knives, wallet chains and mace
Video and audio recording devices, including GoPros and tablets
bagPolicy.note: At Live Nation shows, an unapproved bag can be taken back to your car, or checked at Guest Services (Gate 2) for $10, which includes a clear bag.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Red Hat Amphitheater can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Red Hat Amphitheater's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Red Hat Amphitheater does not allow outside food and beverages, except for one factory-sealed bottle of water per person. The venue has gone cashless, accepting only credit, debit, or mobile payments. Cash can be converted to a prepaid debit card at select shows.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking spaces are located on the first level of parking garages. Accessible drop-off and pick-up areas are located by the Red Hat Amphitheater Box Office near the intersection of Cabarrus and McDowell Streets.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Red Hat Amphitheater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Red Hat Amphitheater. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Red Hat Amphitheater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
